svg.title: DeepPrint Inception and Reduction block anatomy
svg.desc: Five source-checked block diagrams and a serial-repeat example. Faint parallel cells sit behind module labels; the darker cell identifies the Pool path.
svg.text: DeepPrint Inception and Reduction block anatomy
Output of one block → input of the next
Conv: Conv2d → BatchNorm → ReLU. Unmarked ops: stride 1 with size-preserving padding. Tuples: (stride, padding). Pooling: 3×3.
Ops: input → output channels. Edges: output channels. N: batch size (1 for one image). Stacks: repetitions. ⊕: channel-wise concatenation.
